metadata.purpose: Working Ho:YAG thin-disk geometry for simulations after the Rupp rod validation baseline
metadata.note: The original 4 mm diameter x 18 mm Rupp rod remains preserved in config/hoyag_stage0_parameters.json for validation.

numerical_defaults.note: The current optical propagator uses a uniform host refractive index across the FFT window. This is accurate for centrally confined beams far from the 5 mm disk edge; the physical air/YAG edge is not yet a vector boundary-condition model.
